title: SyncNode SSE / Audit Event Contract
description: Canonical event names the backend emits over SSE and records in the audit chain. Electron renders these without importing backend internals. No private chain-of-thought is ever emitted; only decision summaries, tool calls, observations, verification, recovery, and approval.

eventTypes.stream.connected: SSE stream established for a run.
eventTypes.run.created: A run was accepted. payload: goal, model_id.
eventTypes.rag.retrieval.completed: RAG finished. payload: required, reason, tags, documents[], count.
eventTypes.plan.created: Execution plan produced. payload: total_steps, steps[].
eventTypes.plan.validated: Plan sanitized against the tool registry. payload: total_steps, steps[].
eventTypes.agent.spawned: An agent was resolved for a step. payload: agent_id, step_key, action.
eventTypes.agent.plan_summary: Safe, observable agent reasoning summary (not chain-of-thought).
eventTypes.tool.authorized: A tool call passed validation + authorization. payload: tool, agent, step_key, risk.
eventTypes.tool.invoked: A tool call started. payload: step_key, tool_key, inputs (truncated).
eventTypes.tool.started: Execution engine began a tool. payload: tool, agent, step_key.
eventTypes.tool.completed: Tool finished. payload: tool_key, step_key, success.
eventTypes.observation.captured: Environment observed after an action. payload: step_key, ts, observation_id?
eventTypes.screenshot.created: A screenshot observation was captured. payload: observation_id, path, sha256.
eventTypes.target.resolved: A UI/DOM target was uniquely resolved.
eventTypes.target.ambiguous: A UI/DOM target was ambiguous; re-observation needed.
eventTypes.verification.passed: All postconditions passed with real evidence. payload: step_key, assertions.
eventTypes.verification.failed: A postcondition failed. payload: step_key, result, failure_reason.
eventTypes.recovery.triggered: Recovery was invoked. payload: step_key, error_class, tier, attempt.
eventTypes.approval.requested: A sensitive action needs human approval. payload: approval_id, step_key, action, risk.
eventTypes.approval.decided: A human decided an approval. payload: approval_id, decision.
eventTypes.workflow.memory_recorded: The run trajectory was recorded for safe learning. payload: task_type, success, steps.
eventTypes.run.waiting_approval: The run paused at the approval boundary. payload: approval_id, action.
